en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a steamship named "Sundmar" moored in a harbor. The vessel has a tall funnel with an emblem, cargo masts and booms, and several crew visible on deck and in a small rowing boat alongside. On the right side of the image stands a large shed or warehouse beside the water, bearing painted commercial signage. Low wooded hills rise in the distant background, and the water in the foreground is calm, with another small rowboat at left.
